lines.text: Sri Ch. Naveen Kumar, Senior Assistant, Regional Office, Eluru has requested a transfer to Regional Office, Vijayawada on spouse grounds.
In File USD01-12/31/2022-ESTT.I, Note #5, on 20-06-2022, the transfer was approved and orders were issued.
In File USD01-12/77/2023-ESTT.I, Note #5, on 02-09-2023, the transfer was not agreed to at present as the ban on transfers was in force.
In File USD01-12/44/2025-ESTT.I, Note #5, on 27-05-2025, the transfer was approved.
In File USD01-12/58/2025-ESTT.I, Note #4, on 30-05-2025, the transfer was not considered in view of the pending enquiry.
Guidelines and clarifications on station period computation for general transfers 2025 were issued under AP-FIN01-GOMS-31-2025 and AP-FIN01-MEMO-FIN01HRPLG0TRF-3-2025-2-D20250521.
Prior clearance of the Vigilance section is required for transfers of employees facing vigilance enquiries or disciplinary proceedings.
The ban on transfers is relaxed from 15-05-2025 to 31-05-2025, after which the ban comes into force again.
Transfers in any category shall not exceed 15% of the cadre strength without prior concurrence of the Finance Department.
Spouse cases where both spouses are State Government employees shall be given preference subject to availability of vacancy.
The competent authority for transfers of Section Officers and below in the Secretariat Departments is the Secretary to Government of the Department concerned.
The relaxation of the ban on transfers is limited to the period from 15-05-2025 to 31-05-2025.
After 31-05-2025, no transfer shall be ordered without the prior approval of the Government in the Finance Department.
Transfers in any category are restricted to 15% of the cadre strength of that category.
Preference is given to spouse cases where both spouses are State Government employees, subject to vacancy.
Prior clearance of the Vigilance section is required for employees facing vigilance enquiries or disciplinary proceedings.
Review is recommended to verify applicability as the proposal may rely on AP-FIN01-GOMS-88-2022 (03-06-2022), which appears superseded by AP-FIN01-GOMS-31-2025 (12-05-2025).
Review is recommended to verify the authority of AP-FIN01-GOMS-104-2026, which was not found among indexed records.
Review is recommended to confirm if the transfer can be made at this time, as the proposal is dated 22-09-2026, which is outside the relaxation period of 15-05-2025 to 31-05-2025.

Review is recommended to submit the proposal to the Secretary to Government, as the competent authority for Section Officers and below is the Secretary to Government, whereas the proposal seeks approval by the Deputy Secretary.
It is submitted that the request of Sri Ch. Naveen Kumar, Senior Assistant, for transfer to Regional Office, Vijayawada on spouse grounds may kindly be considered.
It is submitted that the proposal may kindly be considered for submission to the Secretary to Government as the competent authority.
It is submitted that prior clearance of the Vigilance section may kindly be considered if the employee is facing vigilance enquiries or disciplinary proceedings.
It is submitted that prior approval of the Government in the Finance Department may kindly be considered if the transfer is ordered after 31-05-2025.
